svg.title: Axiom — Moirai and Aether
svg.desc: Axiom mother brand. Moirai groups Axiom Clotho, planned Axiom Lachesis without self-evolution or RAG, and Axiom Atropos, the selected new name of the existing skill pack. Aether includes planned Axiom Genesis and Axiom Yggdrasil, and planned Axiom Ouroboros for general agent-application self-iteration and evolution including skills. All Aether products are unbuilt.
